deadline.value: The early fall deadline is February 15, 2027; international applicants must submit by May 1.
deadline.quote: February 15 (early), April 15 (regular) and July 15 (late) for fall semester

also.quote: International applicants: May 1 for fall semester

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for this program.
gre_general.quote: Although the Graduate Record Exam (GRE) is not required

gre_subject.value: A general or subject GRE is optional but may help admission.
gre_subject.quote: the general or subject GRE may enhance

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; advisers are appointed to each student after entry.
supervisor.quote: Each specialization committee appoints specific faculty members to advise each incoming student

funding.value: The program page gives no funding rule.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in a natural science or a related field is required; up to 32 master's credits can transfer.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have earned bachelor’s degree in a natural science, mathematics, or other discipline relevant to health and environmental chemistry

also.quote: may request to apply up to 32 credits toward their doctoral degree
